subject: Quick note on Royale Graphics' website
bodyText:
Hi,

I'm Mani from Rogue.

We look for solid businesses that still look stuck online - and Royale Graphics stood out.

Nottingham commercial printers covering business print, design and signage - and royalegraphics.co.uk still pulls html5.js from html5shiv.googlecode.com/svn/trunk, opens with lt-ie9 classes, loads jquery-1.9.0.min.js, and keeps modernizr-2.6.2.min.js on the live shell. Serious Midlands print capacity; a front end still scaffolding for browsers Microsoft retired years ago.

If useful, I'll send a short 3-point teardown over email - what's dated, what's costing you, and the first fix. No call required.

Reply YES and I'll send it.
